comment: Detecting a capability without a realising component is useful, but a model can appear complete even when the realising component is unavailable, non-conformant, poorly governed, or unused.

anchor.note: p.84-85 l.Lines 1162-1169 read as the printed page; section 3.7.4 agrees

public.text: Detecting a capability without a realising component is useful, but a model can appear complete even when the realising component is unavailable, non-conformant, poorly governed, or unused.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish model coverage, deployed coverage, conformant coverage, operational coverage, and effective-use coverage. Do not treat a model relationship alone as evidence that the capability exists in practice.
